name: overdrive
note: --intensity overdrive (choreography.md, Intensity overlays): the trailer's turned-up-to-11 horde, merged over whichever level script the roster picks; tuned by ps-5pd.2 on the timeline's numbers (demo3d/evidence/overdrive/tuning/README.md). It sets its counts and views outright, not as multiples, so every roster set plays the same overdrive: forest's and heroic's 150 at 18 m are real-time cuts, and overdrive is recorded offline (at three times their own they miss the song's on-screen check, as they do at normal). The envelope is three times action-level.json's 425 under a 45 m view (1.5x), since the horde can only walk into the hero's kill zone so fast: at 37.5 m the final peak held 70-85% of its target at its kill rate, at 45 m about 90-100%. The rhythmic sections are where it turns up: the hero's combos play at 2x to 3x, and drop-1, groove-2 and the build add slashR flurries on the eighths between beats (a flurry never costs a beat its blow), about 3 to 3.5 blows a second; drop-2 and the final peak swing once a beat (2.35-2.5 a second) with heavier blows instead, since flurries there split the kills a peak can hold into fewer a blow. yieldToAccents holds back a blow to leave room for a phrase's slam, which otherwise never fits between back-to-back blows. Every monster but the boss dies in one blow (the level script's oneHitKills, ps-7n4), so the loads ask for no hits. Loads: deaths/s per monster on screen 0.08 in drop-1, 0.075 in groove-2 and 0.07 in drop-2 and the final peak, with hit shapes at most a quarter of the view wide. The hero's reach clears a disc as monsters walk into it, and more kills need a wider reach: at 0.09-0.1 and 0.3 of the view the peaks reached 40+ kills a blow but held the horde 10-13 m off a lone hero on an empty floor (and missed their rates on some seeds and under Unity's Mono), while at 0.2 they missed their rates often; these hold their rates and counts on every seed tried, at about 28 and 35 kills a blow, and 0.045 in the build: the build travels to the courtyard, and its hero alone tops out near 28 deaths/s, so it builds tension at a lower rate (0.035 with two hits a death before one-hit kills; the hits are kills now). Spells stay on the phrase and accents (ring, bolt, lightning, and the final peak's laser), so the hero takes 90-98% of the kills. Refills spawn up to max(150, wanted/3) a beat and releases lead by 5 s of deaths, so the horde floods back as fast as it dies; bigger bursts overlapped monsters in the free break before drop-2, whose views are widened (build 41 m, break-2 45 m) so drop-2's horde has room as it fills in. Quiet sections keep their loads (the groove names swarm-light, so every roster set plays the same) and views at the tripled count (groove at 0.17 so its walk-in doesn't overfill, drop-1 at 0.43 for the same reason), so the drops hit harder by load, swing rate and width.

feel.note: The client's response to a blow's kills (camera-and-sound.md, Blow weight; tuned by ps-5pd.3, demo3d/evidence/overdrive/feel/README.md). A blow's weight runs from 0 at 8 kills to 1 at 60, on a log scale.
